title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to get the page number of a PDF or Word file in AL (Display the page count on Attached Documents and Doc. Attachment List Factbox)
summary: This post explains how to retrieve and display page counts for PDF and Word documents in Business Central using AL code. It covers using the PDF Document codeunit to get page counts directly for PDFs and converting Word files to PDF first, with examples for extending document attachment pages.
key_points: Use codeunit 3110 'PDF Document' and its GetPdfPageCount method to retrieve page counts from PDF files
Word files must be converted to PDF first using DocumentReportMgt.ConvertWordToPdf before getting page counts
Extend the Document Attachment table with a PageCount field to store and display page information
Subscribe to the OnBeforeSaveAttachment event to automatically calculate and store page counts when documents are uploaded

quotes.text: By default, Business Central does not display the page count of these files, but if we want to display it, is there any way?
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the problem that motivates the solution of displaying page counts in document attachments

quotes.text: For Word files, we need to convert them to PDF first.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key limitation that Word files require conversion before page counting is possible
